name: Hasumi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Hasumi village emblem in white: a ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes, like a letter E.
history: Flag of the former village of Hasumi in Shimane Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-10-01.

features.role: Hasumi village emblem — a ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes, like a letter E
